title: Northern Mindanao fish farmers told to prevent El Niño fish kills
summary: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — With “super” El Niño threatening local aquaculture, the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources-Region 10 (BFAR-10) urged aquaculture farmers to implement early interventions…

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — With “super” El Niño threatening local aquaculture, the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources-Region 10 (BFAR-10) urged aquaculture farmers to implement early interventions to prevent massive losses. “Don’t wait for fish kills before acting,” BFAR-10 warned in its advisory on Wednesday. “When water heats up and decreases, farmed fish are affected.” The advisory highlighted that El Niño brings hotter weather, reduced rainfall, and water shortages, which alter critical factors like temperature, salinity, and water quality essential for fish health and growth.
